description:
Evaluate a described stablecoin yield position against a research policy (pull).

Always pass your policy rules (or a preset). Without a policy, no meaningful check is possible — the verdict will be review/unknown, never ok.

Pass poolId from yieldhunter list_yields opportunities[].id (also accepted as opportunityId or id). That id is one market. Required for a real check: policyPreset (treasury-conservative | balanced-research | rwa-selective) and/or minScore / maxRewardShare / excludeCategories / maxExitRisk / requireCurated. Presets: treasury-conservative | balanced-research | rwa-selective. rwa-selective does not exclude RWA but is not a free pass (YS policy allowlist + higher bar). requireCurated uses the Yieldsentinel policy allowlist (curated.json), not yieldhunter scoring priors. Scoring ≠ policy approval.

Fetches live yieldhunter research (score, APY, TVL, category, rewardShare, exitRisk) and curated flags, then returns a PolicyVerdict plus A2H (summary, suggestedNextSteps, legend).

Incomplete or missing data is review/unknown — never a silent ok. A verdict is not an exit signal or execution order. Research only — never holds keys.

Example:
{ "poolId": "43641cf5-a92e-416b-bce9-27113d3c0db6", "policyPreset": "treasury-conservative", "notionalUsd": 10000 }

chain.description: ethereum | base | arbitrum. Case-insensitive. Also accepts eth, mainnet, arb, arbitrum-one.

horizonDays.description: Holding horizon in days for net-yield context (default 30).

maxExitRisk.description: Cap on yieldhunter exitRisk heuristic: low | medium | high. Unknown or above the cap → review.

maxRewardShare.description: Maximum incentive share of gross APY (0–1).

minProtocolScore.description: Minimum yieldhunter protocol risk score (0–100, higher = safer).

notionalUsd.description: Research notional in USD (size hint only). Example: 10000

policyPreset.description: Policy preset: "treasury-conservative" | "balanced-research" | "rwa-selective". treasury-conservative excludes RWA; rwa-selective allows RWA but is not a free pass (YS policy allowlist + higher bar).

poolId.description: yieldhunter list_yields opportunities[].id (DefiLlama pool UUID). Example: "43641cf5-a92e-416b-bce9-27113d3c0db6"

protocolSlug.description: Yieldhunter protocol slug. Prefer poolId from list_yields opportunities[].id when the protocol has more than one market.

requireCurated.description: If true, the protocol/pool must be on the Yieldsentinel policy allowlist (curated.json), not yieldhunter scoring priors. Missing allowlist entry → review. Scoring ≠ policy approval.
